title: Ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
body:
abbas e alamdaar abbas e alamdaar
haye haye mere lashkar ke alamdaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
aye mere akhi mere wafadaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
poori karo ab meri tamanna bhi khudara
ye teri wafa hai mujhe moula hi pukaara
aaqa hi pukara
dil hota hai bechain aye ghamkhwaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
ye waqt chalaata hai mere qalb pe khanjar
bedast tujhe dekhu'n bhala kaise baradar
kaisa hai ye manzar
tum hi ho mere jaffar e tayyar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
mere liye baba ne tujhe maanga tha rab se
hasrat hai yahi bhai sunu'n mai tere lab se
bechain hu'n kab se
aye aarzu-e-hydere karrar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat ki ghata chaaro taraf chhayi huwi hai
aankho'n me andhera hai kamar toot gayi hai
haalat ye meri hai
ab hogaya jeena mera dushwaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
toofan e masayeb me ghira mera safeena
yaad aata hai reh rehke bohat hamko madina
roti hai sakina
aulaad e mohammad ke madadgaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ki tarha paala hai maine tujhe bhai
hai khoon ke tar aaj magar meri kamayi
sun meri duhayi
is baat ka hu'n tera talabgaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e jari ne ye kaha shaah se rokar
khaimou'n me meri laash na lejaaye uthakar
ahsaan ho mujhpar
kehne lage rokar shah e abraar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e haram ki hai kamaal anjuman apni
zehra ki duao'n se ye abaad rahegi
nouha wo padhegi
moula ki zubaan par thi jo guftaar
<<MINI>>
ek baar mujhe bhai to kehdo
